An '''antipersonnel field projector''' was a system equipped in the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] ''[[Millennium Falcon]]'' during the [[Battle of Mindor]] between the forces of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], in [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]].<ref name="Mindor">''[[Luke Skywalker and the Shadows of Mindor]]''</ref>
